title: Jacen's Vanilla+
description: A Vanilla+ modpack that aims to improve the vanilla experience without making it feel modded
body:
This is a basic vanilla+ modpack aimed to make the vanilla experience better without making it feel modded.

This modpack includes performance mods as well, so even if you dont have the most powerful pc you can still get decent frames.

Some mods included are: Sodium, Induim, Distant Horizons, Iris, Mouse Tweaks, Nvidium, Qrafty's ____ Villages, Farmers Delight and underground rivers.
